questions.scenario: It's a late-night study session at a friend's house and everyone wants Maggi. What is your role?

options.text: You take charge of the stove, chopping onions and green chilies at lightning speed, handling the heat like a pro.
You read the back of the packet to check the sodium levels and suggest adding boiled veggies to balance the macros.
You carefully plate the Maggi in nice bowls, garnish it with grated cheese and coriander, and take an aesthetic Snapchat before eating.
You tell everyone to GPay you their exact share of the Maggi packets and the cold drinks you bought from the kirana store.

questions.scenario: You are watching MasterChef India with your family. Which part of the show excites you the most?

options.text: The intense pressure tests where contestants run around the pantry, sweating, and cooking three complex dishes in 60 minutes.
The molecular gastronomy tasks, where they use liquid nitrogen and precise chemical reactions to change the texture of the food.
The intricate dessert rounds, featuring massive chocolate domes, spun sugar art, and plating that looks too beautiful to eat.
Wondering how much the winner's future restaurant will actually earn and how they will price their signature dishes.

questions.scenario: It's Diwali and Mummy is making a ton of festive snacks and sweets in the kitchen. How do you help?

options.text: You stand right beside the hot kadhai, actively frying dozens of pooris or gujiyas and managing the chaotic kitchen rush.
You measure the exact ratio of sugar to khoya (milk solids), making sure the sweetness is perfectly balanced and not overpowering.
You take charge of shaping the mithai into perfect little designs and arranging them beautifully on a silver thali for the guests.
You manage the grocery list, calculate how many kilos of maida and ghee are needed, and negotiate prices with the local dairy wala.

questions.scenario: Your friend group is ordering food from Zomato or Swiggy for a hangout. What's your move?

options.text: You immediately suggest ordering the heaviest, most hardcore meal like a full Tandoori Chicken or a massive Biryani handi.
You check the calorie tags on the menu and try to balance the heavy gravy dishes with some tandoori roti and a fresh salad.
You scroll through the pictures on the app, choosing the cafe that serves the most aesthetic freak-shakes or loaded fries.
You apply three different promo codes, split the final bill down to the last rupee on Splitwise, and track the delivery boy's GPS.

questions.scenario: You are eating Momos or Golgappe at a crowded local street vendor. What crosses your mind?

options.text: You love the fast-paced action of the bhaiya serving 10 people at once and try to eat as many spicy golgappas as possible without stopping.
You think about the fermentation process of the momo dough and wonder if the spicy red chutney is irritating your stomach lining.
You notice how the momos are perfectly pleated and wish you could learn how to fold them into those exact little intricate shapes.
You look at the massive crowd around the stall and quickly calculate how much daily profit the bhaiya makes in a single evening.

questions.scenario: Your class is setting up a food stall for the school farewell party. What is your assigned role?

options.text: Standing behind the counter, tossing noodles in a huge wok, sweating but loving the adrenaline rush of serving hungry seniors fast.
Ensuring the food is stored at the right temperature so nobody gets food poisoning, and measuring ingredients to maintain consistent taste.
Setting up a beautiful mocktail or cupcake counter with colorful paper umbrellas, fairy lights, and fancy garnishes.
Deciding the prices for the food coupons, managing the cash box, and making sure the stall makes enough profit to cover the DJ costs.

questions.scenario: It's morning and you have to pack your own school tiffin/lunchbox. How do you do it?

options.text: You quickly whip up a fast and filling Anda Bhurji (egg scramble) or Masala Poha in 5 minutes flat before the school bus arrives.
You make sure your tiffin has the right balance of proteins, complex carbs, and veggies to keep your energy up during the PT period.
You try to make your lunchbox look incredibly cute, cutting fruits into star shapes and rolling your chapati neatly like a wrap.
You pack extra food, knowing exactly which friend will trade their expensive imported chocolate for your homemade aloo parathas.

questions.scenario: You are visiting a fancy, expensive new cafe in your city. What grabs your attention first?

options.text: Trying to peek into the open kitchen, watching the chefs shout out order tickets and handle multiple frying pans at the same time.
Reading the menu descriptions deeply, trying to identify all the exotic herbs and exact imported ingredients they used in the pasta sauce.
Spending 10 minutes taking photos of the incredible latte art and the perfectly layered cheesecake from different angles before taking a bite.
Judging the ambiance, the seating turnover rate, and discussing with your friends why this cafe's location will or won't make it successful.

questions.scenario: A cooking disaster happens at home (e.g., the dal is way too salty). How do you save the day?

options.text: You jump into action, quickly boiling a raw potato to drop into the dal to absorb the salt, fixing it on the fly under pressure.
You analyze exactly where the measurement went wrong and make a mental note of the precise salt-to-water ratio for the next time.
You try to mask the mistake by adding a beautiful, aromatic tadka on top with roasted red chilies and fresh coriander to distract everyone.
You decide it's not worth serving, immediately order a backup paneer dish from a nearby dhaba, and manage the family's hunger tantrums.

questions.scenario: If you started a Food YouTube channel today, what would your content be about?

options.text: A high-energy, fast-paced vlog where you cook giant quantities of street-style food on massive iron tawas and woks.
A deep-dive video explaining the exact science of why dough rises, the Maillard reaction in searing meat, and decoding food myths.
A visually stunning, ASMR-style baking channel where you make multi-tiered wedding cakes with intricate fondant flowers.
A business review channel where you interview successful Indian restaurant owners about how they built their food empires from scratch.

Executive_Chef.title: The Kitchen Commander (Executive / Line Chef)
Executive_Chef.primary_match_text: You are a fast-paced action hero! You thrive in chaos, love the heat of the kitchen, and have the physical stamina to whip up incredible meals under intense pressure.
Executive_Chef.day_in_the_life: Running a busy five-star hotel kitchen, shouting out orders, perfectly cooking 50 dishes an hour, and ensuring every plate leaves the kitchen hot and delicious.
Executive_Chef.alternative_match_text: Your high energy and ability to handle chaos would also make you a great Event Manager or Operations Lead.
Executive_Chef.roadmap: 11th/12th Any Stream -> Clear NCHMCT JEE -> B.Sc in Hospitality & Hotel Administration or BA in Culinary Arts -> 6-month rigorous hotel kitchen internship.

Food_Scientist.title: The Flavor Genius (Food Scientist / Nutritionist)
Food_Scientist.primary_match_text: You are the logic master of the kitchen! You know that cooking isn't just an art; it's pure chemistry, biology, and math all rolled into one.
Food_Scientist.day_in_the_life: Working in a food lab or FMCG company, testing new flavors for snacks, calculating exact nutritional values, and making sure packed food stays fresh longer.
Food_Scientist.alternative_match_text: Your analytical brain and love for food biology make you a perfect fit for a Dietitian, Quality Assurance Inspector, or Lab Researcher.
Food_Scientist.roadmap: 11th/12th Science (PCB/PCM) or Home Science -> B.Sc in Food Technology, Nutrition & Dietetics, or Home Science -> Master's in Food Science.

Pastry_Chef.title: The Dessert Artist (Pastry Chef / Food Stylist)
Pastry_Chef.primary_match_text: You have an incredible eye for aesthetics! For you, food is a canvas. You love patience, precision, and making dishes that look so beautiful they belong in a museum.
Pastry_Chef.day_in_the_life: Baking massive, intricate wedding cakes, tempering chocolate, piping perfect macarons, or styling food beautifully for magazine photoshoots and TV ads.
Pastry_Chef.alternative_match_text: Your creative superpower and steady hands would also make you an amazing Graphic Designer, Fine Artist, or Make-up Artist.
Pastry_Chef.roadmap: 11th/12th Any Stream -> Diploma or Degree in Bakery and Confectionery / Culinary Arts from top institutes like IHM or specialized baking schools.

Restaurant_Owner.title: The Food Boss (Restaurant / Cafe Owner)
Restaurant_Owner.primary_match_text: You are a visionary leader with a business mind! You don't just want to cook the food; you want to own the entire empire, manage the people, and count the profits.
Restaurant_Owner.day_in_the_life: Designing the cafe's aesthetic, negotiating with food suppliers, hiring the best chefs, planning the menu pricing, and marketing your restaurant to the city.
Restaurant_Owner.alternative_match_text: Your leadership and strategic thinking make you perfect for roles like Business Entrepreneur, Marketing Head, or Hospitality Manager.
Restaurant_Owner.roadmap: 11th/12th Commerce or Any Stream -> Degree: BBA, B.Com, or Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM) -> MBA in Hospitality Management or Entrepreneurship.
